title: Issue #206: [P0] Bind delivery evidence to exact source SHAs and workflow runs
content:
State: open

## Goal
Make the ecosystem evidence registry mechanically auditable and prevent stale evidence from being mistaken for current verification.

## Scope
Extend the delivery registry/evidence validation path to record repository, source SHA, workflow/run URL, gate name, result, timestamp, environment and acceptance criterion.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every VERIFIED entry contains a concrete source SHA and retrievable workflow/test evidence.
- [ ] Validator flags absent SHAs, absent run references and evidence whose SHA differs from the assessed revision.
- [ ] IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, AUDITED and PRODUCTION_READY remain distinct states with documented transition criteria.
- [ ] Stale evidence is visibly marked stale, not silently reused.
- [ ] Tests include valid evidence, missing fields, SHA mismatch and stale run.
- [ ] The validator's CI run and tested SHA are linked in the PR.

## Dependencies
None; this can proceed in parallel with contract work.
